headline: Wake Forest climbs to fifteen wins
dek: Wake Forest has won fifteen matches and lost three, scoring 41 goals and conceding sixteen after beating Boston University away. That leaves it ahead of Notre Dame in overall wins despite finishing behind it in the conference table.
displaced_by: North Carolina's eighteenth win made the previous dek stale; Wake Forest reached fifteen wins at Boston University
